newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates largely higher on U.S. hike.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates largely higher on U.S. hike.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) climbed in most maturities on Wednesday following the hike in U.S. interest rates, traders said.
Only the one-week rate was steady.
On Tuesday, the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee raised the federal funds by 0.25 percentage points in a bid to check U.S. inflation.
PHIBOR represents rates at which banks would be willing to swap their pesos for dollars.
